title: How do you get a perfect white background without clipping the product?
h1: How do you get a perfect white background without clipping the product?
metaTitle: Pro photo white background without retouching: Expert method in 3 min 📸
description: Learn how to get the perfect white background without clipping for your products. This method is facilitated by the Orbitvu Station software and mandatory for perfect videos of your products.
tool: Orbitvu Station software and a ring
introText:
Whether for e-commerce or advertising, an impeccable white background is essential for professional product visuals. It guarantees a homogeneous and neat image, while avoiding long and expensive retouching. 🎨

Although the Orbitvu automated photo studios allow you to automatically crop your photos with theIQ Mask, this function is not available for video. Through this guide, discover our simple and effective method for obtaining a perfect white background without clipping.

‍

steps.title: Position the product and choose the right lighting
steps.content:
Start by placing your product in the center of the photo studio, using the center guide on the turntable. 📍 Make sure the object is centered on your screen.

On the lighting side, select a predefined template to help and inspire you. 💡

tip : If you're shooting reflective objects, adjust the angle of the light sources slightly to avoid annoying reflections.
steps.structuredText: Start by positioning your product in the center of the photo studio turntable, using the central coordinate system for accurate placement. Check the alignment on the preview screen to make sure the object is fully centered. On the lighting side, select a predefined template to benefit from a quick and consistent adjustment. Tip: If you're working with reflective objects, adjust the angle of the light sources slightly to reduce unwanted reflections.

steps.title: Adjust light and camera settings
steps.content:
Adjust light intensities to avoid overexposure or reflections. On the camera side, apply these settings: 📷

  • Opening : f/14 or f/16 (for a good depth of field)
  • ISO : Around 600 (to minimize noise)
  • Shutter speed : 1/80

Remember to save your settings to ensure consistency across all your shots and save time. 📂
steps.structuredText: Adjust the intensity of the light sources to avoid overexposure or reflections on the product. On the camera side, apply the following settings to ensure a sharp and balanced image: Aperture: f/14 or f/16 for optimal depth of field ISO: approximately 600 to minimize digital noise Shutter speed: 1/80. Once you have found the right settings, remember to save them as a template to ensure consistency across all your shots and save time in future sessions.

steps.title: Start shooting
steps.content:
Before shooting, take a photo by yourself to make sure your settings are optimal.

When everything is ready, click “Capture All” or “Save” for a video. 🎬
steps.structuredText: Before shooting, take a photo by yourself to make sure your settings are optimal. When everything is ready, click “Capture All” or “Save” for a video.

steps.title: Adjust the histogram
steps.content:
Switch to edit mode in Orbitvu Station. The first step is to adjust the histogram to refine the exposure. 🎨

Click on theDrop icon at the top right of the tool histogram to access level settings.
steps.structuredText: Switch to edit mode in Orbitvu Station. The first step is to adjust the histogram to refine the exposure. Click the drop icon at the top right of the histogram tool to access level settings.

steps.title: Perfect the white background
steps.content:
To get pure white, uselevel tool. Lower level 250 gradually until the bottom becomes Entirely red, anything that is red will turn white once validated.

Click on the drop again to see the final result. This technique guarantees a uniform white background without clipping and without tedious retouching.
steps.structuredText: To get pure white, use the levels tool. Gradually lower the 250 level until the background turns completely red, everything that is red will turn white once validated. Click on the drop again to see the final result. This technique guarantees a uniform white background without clipping and without tedious retouching.

steps.title: Export and publish your photos
steps.content:
Once the rendering has been validated, export your images in the format that best suits your needs: JPEG for maximum compatibility, PNG if you need a transparent background, MP4 for a video... 📤

Also, find out how to get consistent visuals for an entire collection of products.

faqs.question: Is this method suitable for a large volume of products?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is ideal for large e-commerce catalogs. Once the parameters are defined, they can be automatically applied to each session, ensuring visual consistency across all products.

faqs.question: Does this method reduce the cost of creating visuals?
faqs.answer: Yes, it eliminates the need for manual editing and minimizes the time spent on each shot. Automating settings makes it possible to quickly produce quality visuals, which avoids the additional expenses associated with clipping services.

faqs.question: What accessories can help improve the quality of the white background?
faqs.answer: Light diffusers, reflective panels, and anti-glare supports can help homogenize lighting and avoid unwanted reflections on some products. These accessories are already present in the Alphashot Pro G2

faqs.question: What is the difference between a white background obtained by this method and a white background generated in post-production?
faqs.answer: A white background obtained directly during the shooting is more natural, with no artificial cutting effect. It is also faster to produce and requires no additional retouching, unlike manual clipping which can be time-consuming.

faqs.question: How can I prevent the product from appearing too detached from the white background?
faqs.answer: To maintain a natural look, it is possible to add a slight shadow under the object by adjusting the lighting on the ground or in post-production with Orbitvu Station.
